# Scan My Shadow

> Scan My Shadow is a digital privacy service. For a one-time fee ($9.99, or ₹498 in India) it scans a phone number and email address against 1,500+ breach and public-data sources and delivers a report of what is exposed. The site also offers free breach and exposure checks and publishes plain-English guides on digital footprints, data breaches, hacked accounts and scams, with a focus on India.

Site: https://www.scanmyshadow.com/
